We’re not going to talk about that, though.
lines.zh: 不过我们不打算谈那个。

lines.en: You see, there comes a time in every man’s life where he must get his priorities in order.
lines.zh: 你要知道，每个男人一生中总有那么一个时刻，必须把自己的优先顺序理清楚。

lines.en: Just take a look at Haruka. She clearly has her priorities in order, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: 就看看 Haruka 吧。她显然把自己的优先顺序理得很清楚，不是吗？

lines.en: The point is that I would be a fool to let what comes to me at night leak out into this room so full of color when this is supposed to be a happy day.
lines.zh: 重点是，在这么一个本该快乐的日子里，我要是让夜晚降临到我身上的东西，渗进这间色彩斑斓的屋子，那我可就蠢透了。

lines.en: This is supposed to be a happy day.
lines.zh: 今天本该是快乐的一天。

lines.en: This is supposed to-
lines.zh: 本该是——

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Hi, Tsuneyo. Why is everyone still dressed like it’s Halloween?
lines.zh: : 你好，Tsuneyo。为什么大家还穿着万圣节的装扮？

lines.en: : Don’t ask questions. Just accept it.
lines.zh: : 别问。接受就好。

lines.en: : The reason is quite simple, Sir. The idea of a group-wide contest is much more alluring when we’ve all got a different set of skin on, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 原因很简单，先生。当我们都换上另一层皮的时候，一场全员参与的比赛就更加诱人了，不是吗？

lines.en: : We figured the safest way to even the playing field was by having {i}everyone{/i} keep their costume on so no one girl would have an unfair advantage if she decided to do it on her own.
lines.zh: : 我们认为，要拉平赛场最保险的办法，就是让{i}每个人{/i}都穿着装扮——这样就算有谁想单独行动，也不会占到不公平的便宜。

lines.en: : You really think I would go out my way to give a victory to a girl just because she dressed up for the occasion?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会因为一个女孩为了这个场合精心打扮，就特意把胜利送给她？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Then you underestimate how seriously I take this, Molly.
lines.zh: : 那你可低估了我对这件事有多认真，Molly。

lines.en: : Sir, do you even remember what Sana and I will be competing in today?
lines.zh: : 先生，您还记得今天 Sana 和我要比什么吗？

lines.en: : If it’s anything other than video games, you sure picked a strange location for the contest.
lines.zh: : 如果不是电子游戏的话，那你们选的比赛地点可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : Oh-ho, so you really {i}do{/i} remember. Then tell me, Sir. Whose side are you on? Who are you rooting for?
lines.zh: : 哦——呵，您居然真的{i}记得{/i}。那么告诉我，先生。您站在哪一边？您支持谁？

lines.en: : Am I even allowed to choose sides? Wouldn’t that be a display of bias? Also, where is Imani? Isn’t she supposed to be doing this with me?
lines.zh: : 我还能选边站吗？那不就成了偏袒？还有，Imani 在哪儿？她不是该和我一起主持吗？

lines.en: scene gamerbattle2
: That’s a good question. Nobody’s seen her since she followed us home from school yesterday.
lines.zh: : 问得好。自从昨天放学后她跟着我们回家，就没人再见过她了。

lines.en: : I believe this may be my fault. I have grown too powerful.
lines.zh: : 我想这也许是我的错。我变得太强大了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo’s racial passive gives her charm skill an added bonus of lasting...forever.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 的种族被动让她的魅惑技能获得了额外的加成——持续时间……永远。

lines.en: : I would like to thank my ancestors for whatever may have caused this.
lines.zh: : 我要感谢我的祖先，无论是什么造就了这一点。

lines.en: : Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Actually, never mind. It is inconvenient and I worry that I am not responsible enough for such a dangerous ability.
lines.zh: : 其实，当我没说。这太不方便了，而且我担心自己还不够成熟，担不起这么危险的能力。

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me while I go stand in the corner and prevent anyone else from falling in love.
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了，我要去角落里站着，防止再有任何人坠入爱河。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle3
: Nooooo! Come back!
: Are you about ready to begin, Sir? We’ve been waiting on you this entire time.
lines.zh: : 您准备好开始了吗，先生？我们可是一直在等您。

lines.en: : To be honest, I assumed you’d be showing up with Ami. But I suppose even you two must spend some time apart every now and then.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我以为您会和 Ami 一起出现。不过我想，就算是你们俩，偶尔也得分开一会儿吧。

lines.en: : We spend plenty of time apart. I came here alone today. But yeah. If you guys are ready to go, then-
lines.zh: : 我们分开的时间够多了。今天我是一个人来的。不过好吧。如果你们准备好了，那就——

lines.en: scene gamerbattle4
: S...Sorry I’m late...My mom...took extra long to...get ready this morning...
lines.zh: : 对……对不起我迟到了……我妈妈……今天早上……花了特别长的时间打扮……

lines.en: : Sana?...
lines.zh: : Sana？……

lines.en: : But...wait. If you’re in {i}that{/i} costume again, who is it in the dolphin costume? I assumed you’d just swapped back into ole reliable after realizing how atro- err...{i}attractive{/i} that costume is.
lines.zh: : 可是……等等。如果你又穿上了{i}这身{/i}，那穿海豚装的是谁？我还以为你意识到那身装扮有多糟——呃……多{i}迷人{/i}之后，会换回那套老可靠的。

lines.en: : That costume...belonged to my mom, so...I’m sure there are...other people who have it as well...
lines.zh: : 那身衣服……是我妈妈的，所以……我相信……也会有别人有……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle5

: Well, that said, I suppose our death march is about to commence! Bequeath unto me your hand so that we may perform a blood oath and ensure that neither one of us backs down once we face certain doom!
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我想我们的死亡行军就要开始了！把你的手交给我，好让我们立下血誓，确保在面对注定的厄运时谁也不会退缩！

lines.en: : B...Blood oath?....Can’t we just...play games without hurting ourselves?...
lines.zh: : 血……血誓？……我们就不能……只是打游戏，不弄伤自己吗？……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle6
: Aw, man. I really wanted to do the blood oath. But I suppose that would just lead to a slew of problems when it comes to operating the machines, so...
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我真的很想立血誓。不过我想那样在操作机器时会惹出一堆麻烦，所以……

lines.en: scene black
: Fine! Come with me, Not-Zagull! Our first of three games will begin in mere moments!
lines.zh: : 好吧！跟我来，冒牌 Zagull！三场比赛中的第一场，马上就要开始了！

lines.en: : Master! Sir! Whatever your preference for pet name is! Feel free to grind your social links in the meantime while Sana and I get into position!
lines.zh: : 主人！先生！随您喜欢怎么称呼！趁 Sana 和我各就各位，您尽管去刷您的社交链接吧！

lines.en: : What’s a social link?
lines.zh: : 什么是社交链接？

lines.en: : Just talk to the Magistrate of Mammaries and tell her to put her breasts away during the competition or they’re going to distract me!
lines.zh: : 就去跟「乳房治安官」说一声，让她在比赛期间把胸收起来，不然会让我分心！

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle7
: Hey. Molly wants you to flash her for good luck. I told her it was a bad idea, but girls will be girls.
lines.zh: : 嘿。Molly 要你露一下，给她求个好运。我说了那是个馊主意，可女生就是女生。

lines.en: : Weird. She’s never responded to any of the three times I accidentally sent her pictures of them, so I assumed she just wasn’t interested.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我之前不小心给她发过三次那种照片，她一次都没回过，所以我还以为她根本不感兴趣呢。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I won’t be as mean if you ever accidentally send them to me.
lines.zh: : 别担心。要是你哪天不小心发给我，我不会那么刻薄。

lines.en: : Hi. Idol Sara here and ready for you to pay attention to me next. Tell me how cute I am.
lines.zh: : 嗨。偶像 Sara 在此，准备好让你把注意力转到我身上了。说说我有多可爱。

lines.en: : You are very cute.
lines.zh: : 你非常可爱。

lines.en: : Great. Now take my credit card, walk three blocks south, and look for the giant, neon diamond sign right above the big, red letters that spell out “ENGAGEMENT RINGS.”
lines.zh: : 很好。现在拿着我的信用卡，往南走三个街区，找那个巨大的霓虹钻石招牌——就在那排拼成「订婚戒指」的大红字正上方。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle8
: I don’t think you’re supposed to pay for your own engagement ring.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己的订婚戒指不该由自己付钱吧。

lines.en: : You’re not. But, let’s be real, there’s no way Sensei would actually buy one and I am willing to take this financial hit if it means getting some stability back in my life.
lines.zh: : 确实不该。但说实话，老师根本不可能真去买一个，而我愿意承受这笔经济损失，只要能让我的生活重新稳定下来。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳哼。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle9
if sarasex == True:
: What? This knot is ready to be tied.
lines.zh: : 怎么？这个结已经可以打了。

lines.en: else:
: Blah, blah, let’s stay friends, blah. Who says friends can’t get married anyway?
lines.zh: : blah blah，什么「我们还是做朋友吧」，blah。谁说朋友不能结婚的？

lines.en: : Okay. I’m just going to talk to Haruka now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我现在只跟 Haruka 说话。

lines.en: : And what? Ask her to flash you next?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？让她也露一下给你看？

lines.en: : No. Ask her why you two decided to come here when this contest doesn’t really have anything to do with you.
lines.zh: : 不。问问她，既然这场比赛跟你们没什么关系，你们俩干嘛要来。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle10
: Oh! We started a betting pool. I’ve got 10,000 yen on Sana taking down Molly in two rounds.
lines.zh: : 哦！我们搞了个赌局。我押了 1 万日元，赌 Sana 两回合内干掉 Molly。

lines.en: : And I’ve got that same bet on Molly winning in three.
lines.zh: : 而我押了同样的注，赌 Molly 三回合取胜。

lines.en: : Should I be betting against Sara knowing that her financial life is hanging on by a thread? No. But if she’s going to keep being frivolous with her money, it is my job to teach her a lesson.
lines.zh: : 明知道 Sara 的财务状况已经命悬一线，我还该跟她对着押吗？不该。但如果她还要继续乱花钱，那我的职责就是给她一个教训。

lines.en: : Also, if Molly loses this contest when she spends roughly 75%% of every work day playing games on her phone, I am going to be extremely disappointed in her.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果 Molly 把每个工作日大约 75%% 的时间都花在手机上打游戏，却还输掉这场比赛，那我对她会非常失望。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, best of luck to you two and enjoy your time reliving your glory days by hanging out in an arcade full of teenagers.
lines.zh: : 那么，祝你们两位好运，好好享受在一群青少年中间重温光辉岁月的感觉吧。

lines.en: : I wasn’t really cool enough to ever get invited anywhere like this.
lines.zh: : 我以前可没酷到会被邀请来这种地方。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me you’ve never been banged on an air hockey table before? How are we even friends?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你从来没在空气曲棍球桌上被干过？那我们怎么还算朋友？

lines.en: : Have...have you?
lines.zh: : 你……你有吗？

lines.en: scene gamerbattle11
: Hey, you two. What’s-
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们俩。什么——

lines.en: : Shh. You’re going to scare it away.
lines.zh: : 嘘。你会把它吓跑的。

lines.en: : Scare what away?
lines.zh: : 把什么吓跑？

lines.en: : The dolphin.
lines.zh: : 那只海豚。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 它只是……

lines.en: : It’s just...{i}standing{/i} there...
lines.zh: : 只是……{i}站在那儿{/i}……

lines.en: : Oh, come on. It’s obviously just one of the girls in a joke costume.
lines.zh: : 拜托。那明摆着就是哪个姑娘穿了套搞笑服装而已。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s completely harmless.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定它完全无害。

lines.en: scene sexyland
scene sexyland2
scene sexyland
scene gamerbattle12
: Okay. That’s enough of you.
lines.zh: : 好了。你差不多得了。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle13
: I’m going to talk to you two now since I no longer like dolphins.
lines.zh: : 我现在要跟你们俩说话了，因为我已经不喜欢海豚了。

lines.en: : I had no idea you ever liked them in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道你原来喜欢过它们。

lines.en: : Were you able to find out who’s inside? Because I would be willing to bet money on it being Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你查出里面是谁了吗？因为我愿意赌一把，那人准是 Ayane。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle14
: How much money?
lines.zh: : 赌多少？

lines.en: : At least-
lines.zh: : 至少——

lines.en: scene gamerbattle15
: Oh, god damn it.
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。

lines.en: : I’m glad you were able to get out of bed, Sensei. I tried shaking you for a good twenty minutes and, if it weren’t for the fact that you were still breathing, I probably would have just killed myself.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴您总算能起床了，老师。我试着摇了您整整二十分钟，要不是您还有气，我大概已经自我了断了。

lines.en: : I’m also glad you made it! But I don’t really have anything that depressing to add, so I’ll just remind you that it’s because I love you.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴您来了！不过我实在没什么同样丧的话可补充，那就提醒您一句——那是因为我爱你。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle16
: And I...don’t care. Besides, aren’t you supposed to be judging something right now? Because I can hear Molly yelling from here and it sounds like they’re about to start.
lines.zh: : 而我……不在乎。再说了，你现在不是该去当裁判吗？我在这里都能听见 Molly 在喊，听起来她们要开始了。

lines.en: : Is there even anything {i}for{/i} me to judge? I figured they were just going to play a few games and...whoever won, won.
lines.zh: : 有什么需要{i}我{/i}评判的吗？我以为她们就是打几局游戏……谁赢了就算谁赢。

lines.en: : I’m quite sure that’s how it will be, yes. I just wanted to try and say something that would get you to leave. It appears that I have failed.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定就是这样，没错。我只是想试着说点什么好让你走开。看来我失败了。

lines.en: : Wow, you’re not holding back at all today, are you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你今天可真是一点都不留情面啊。

lines.en: : Maya’s a little nervous that she’s going to have to dress up like a maid and say nice things to you.
lines.zh: : Maya 有点紧张，因为她得穿成女仆的样子，还得对你说好听的话。

lines.en: : I’d like to make it known that there is an extreme difference between “nervous” and “nauseous.”
lines.zh: : 我想声明一下，「紧张」和「恶心」之间有着极大的区别。

lines.en: : And I’d like to make it known that, once again, I have nothing to add but the fact that I love you.
lines.zh: : 而我也想声明一下，我再一次没什么可补充的，只有一件事——我爱你。

lines.en: : Well, here’s hoping your stand-up routine tonight has a little more to go off than just that.
lines.zh: : 那么，希望你今晚的单口表演能比这句话多点料。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle17
: Heh...heheh...
: Yeah...how’s that going, by the way? You were up really late practicing, weren’t-
lines.zh: : 是啊……话说回来，准备得怎么样了？你昨晚练到很晚吧——

lines.en: : Oh, look! The...contest is...woo! Go Sana!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！比赛……哇哦！Sana 加油！

lines.en: scene gamerbattle18

: Round one is a test of dexterity! A test of how limber these bodies are and of how gamers aren’t {i}always{/i} strapped down to a chair with a half empty can of Monster on their desk! Just...most of the time!
lines.zh: : 第一回合考验的是灵巧！考验这些身体有多柔韧，也考验玩家并不{i}总是{/i}被绑在椅子上、桌上摆着半罐喝剩的 Monster！只是……大部分时候是这样！

lines.en: : I can’t...drink that stuff...It makes my heart...explode...
lines.zh: : 我……喝不了那东西……它会让我的心脏……爆炸……

lines.en: : You expect to defeat {i}Molly MacCormack{/i} with a tolerance that weak? Don’t make me laugh.
lines.zh: : 就凭你这么点耐受力，还想击败 {i}Molly MacCormack{/i}？别逗我笑了。

lines.en: : The objective of this game is simple- the first one to make it to the finish line after three laps is the winner.
lines.zh: : 这个游戏的目标很简单——跑完三圈后第一个冲过终点线的人获胜。

lines.en: : So it’s...like Mario Kart, but...on a...machine?...
lines.zh: : 所以就是……像马力欧卡丁车，但是……在一台……机器上？……

lines.en: : Are there any powerups?...Or...other things I should know about?...Because it’s my first time...playing this game and...
lines.zh: : 有没有什么道具？……或者……我该知道的其他东西？……因为这是我第一次……玩这个游戏，而且……

lines.en: : It might be unfair if...if you’ve played it before...
lines.zh: : 如果你……以前玩过的话……可能不太公平……

lines.en: : It’s as plain as day, Not-Zagull. You just drive as fast as you can and try to reach the end before your opponent.
lines.zh: : 这再明白不过了，冒牌 Zagull。你只管尽快开，抢在对手之前到达终点就行。

lines.en: : No turtles...no stars...just raw speed...
lines.zh: : 没有乌龟……没有星星……纯粹就是速度……

lines.en: : Why, it feels like just yesterday that my family and I were taking turns getting railed on this very machine.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，感觉就像昨天一样，我和家人还在这台机器上轮流被干。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle19
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : It was my first time, so I was worried that I might do something wrong. And while it started off very bumpy and hard, it felt very smooth by the end!
lines.zh: : 那是我第一次，所以我很担心自己会做错什么。虽然一开始很颠簸也很硬，但到后面就变得非常顺滑了！

lines.en: : My younger sister was able to pick up on it almost immediately, though. My mother and I were in awe. You should have seen how deftly she handled the “shafts.”
lines.zh: : 不过我妹妹几乎是一下子就上手了。我和母亲都惊叹不已。你真该看看她操纵那几根「杆子」有多灵巧。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: The...sh...shafts?...
lines.zh: : 那几根……杆……杆子？……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle20
: In the end, after my sister was railed to her heart’s content, it was my turn to rail my mother.
lines.zh: : 最后，在我妹妹被干得心满意足之后，就轮到我去干我母亲了。

lines.en: : It’s a special thing, railing one’s mother. And I was very worried that I might disappoint her. But we reached the finish line within seconds of one another and...my. It was a surprisingly intimate experience.
lines.zh: : 干自己的母亲，是一件特别的事。我当时很担心会让她失望。但我们前后只差几秒就冲过了终点线，而且……哎呀。那真是一次意外亲密的体验。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle21
: Uta? Did I say something wrong?
lines.zh: : Uta？我是不是说错什么了？

lines.en: : Perhaps we can rail each other once these two are done? I’m sure you’ll love it.
lines.zh: : 也许等她们俩结束之后，我们可以互相干一场？我相信你会喜欢的。

lines.en: scene black
Winner of Game 1:\nSana Sakakibara
lines.zh:
第一局胜者：
Sana Sakakibara

lines.en: scene gamerbattle22
: Okay, listen up! The only reason you were able to eke out a victory is because I was distracted by things I thought only happened in visual novels!
lines.zh: : 好，听好了！你能勉强赢下这一局，唯一的原因就是我被那些我以为只会在视觉小说里发生的事情分了心！

lines.en: : Are you sure I’m not just...better than you?...
lines.zh: : 你确定不是因为我……本来就比你强？……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle23
: Oh? What’s this? I had no idea Zagull had been sneaking points into {i}charisma{/i} behind his DM’s back. Remind me to review your character sheet before our next session, petulant whelp.
lines.zh: : 哦？这是什么？我可不知道 Zagull 居然背着他的 DM 偷偷往{i}魅力{/i}上加点。提醒我下次开团前先检查你的角色卡，任性的小崽子。

lines.en: : You’re...doing a lot of talking for...someone who’s about to lose her...second game in a row...
lines.zh: : 你……话可真多啊……对于一个马上要连输第二局的人来说……

lines.en: : And you’re sounding rather confident for someone who only managed to win because of a fluke.
lines.zh: : 而你听起来也相当自信嘛，对于一个只是靠侥幸才赢了一局的人来说。

lines.en: : Now, we’ve returned to my realm. Miles and miles away from the realm of games that require your full body rather than just your hands.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们回到了我的领域。与那些需要你全身投入、而不只是动手的游戏，相距千里万里。

lines.en: : In round two...we fight. To the death. But, fair warning Zagull, years of grinding away at mobile games has caused my reflexes to develop into something you should truly fear.
lines.zh: : 第二回合……我们要战斗。至死方休。不过先说好，Zagull，长年在手机游戏上苦练，已经把我的反应速度锻炼成了你真正该畏惧的东西。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle24
: See...that’s where you’re wrong, Molly...
lines.zh: : 你看……这就是你错的地方，Molly……

lines.en: : Because...the only thing I fear....
lines.zh: : 因为……我唯一害怕的东西……

lines.en: : Is spaghetti...
lines.zh: : 是意大利面……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle25
: Is...what?!
: Die! Die! Die!!!
lines.zh: : 去死！去死！去死！！！

lines.en: scene gamerbattle26
: Ah! You bastard! I should have known you’d employ some sort of distraction! No one’s actually afraid of spaghetti!
lines.zh: : 啊！你这混蛋！我早该知道你会用某种干扰手段！根本没有人真的怕意大利面！

lines.en: : I am! And I...don’t care who knows it anymore!
lines.zh: : 我怕！而且我……已经不在乎谁知道了！

lines.en: scene black
: What does that even mean?!
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思啊？！

lines.en: Winner of Game 2:\nMolly MacCormack
lines.zh:
第二局胜者：
Molly MacCormack

lines.en: scene gamerbattle27
: So...um...now that we’re tied at...one win each...what are we doing for our last game?...
lines.zh: : 那么……嗯……既然现在……一比一打平了……最后一场我们玩什么？……

lines.en: : I don’t really know. Whatever this machine is, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我也不太清楚。就看这台机器是什么吧。

lines.en: : I want our last match to be fair and balanced, and I’ve already played everything else inside of this arcade.
lines.zh: : 我希望最后一场公平公正，而这家游戏厅里其他的东西我早就玩遍了。

lines.en: : Then...isn’t it...unfair to you if you go first? Since you’ll be using your turn...figuring out how everything works...
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你先来的话，对你……不是不公平吗？因为你要用你那一轮……去摸索这一切怎么玩……

lines.en: : Probably. But I’m the one who’s chosen all of the games so far, so it’s only fair that if either one of us receives a handicap, it should be you.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过到目前为止游戏都是我挑的，所以如果我们俩当中要有一个人吃点亏，那应该是你，这样才公平。

lines.en: : Can you two hurry it up? I’m just seconds away from another quote against a sky background.
lines.zh: : 你们俩能不能快点？我离下一句「天空背景配名言」只差几秒了。

lines.en: : I suppose we should start our final round before our teacher becomes fish food. It will be hard for him to judge the following contests if he’s decomposing at the bottom of the ocean.
lines.zh: : 我想我们该开始最后一场了，免得我们的老师变成鱼食。如果他正在海底腐烂分解，那接下来的比赛他就不好评判了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Molly. That’s exactly what I wanted to hear.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Molly。这正是我想听的话。

lines.en: : I think this...is some kind of...escape game...
lines.zh: : 我觉得这……是某种……密室逃脱游戏……

lines.en: : I used to...play a lot of these...when I still lived with my mom...
lines.zh: : 我以前……玩过很多这种……在我还和妈妈住在一起的时候……

lines.en: : Yes, it appears there’s a timer ticking down as well. So we only have five minutes to get out of this house before the game ends.
lines.zh: : 是的，看起来还有个计时器在倒计时。所以我们只有五分钟时间，得在游戏结束前逃出这栋房子。

lines.en: : It...would probably be best if we work together then...
lines.zh: : 那……我们最好还是合作吧……

lines.en: : You’re right. An extra set of eyes will make it so we can cover twice as much ground in the same amount of time. Good thinking, Zagull.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。多一双眼睛，就能让我们在同样的时间里搜两倍的范围。想法不错，Zagull。

lines.en: : You cover the left side of the house while I look for anything interesting on the right.
lines.zh: : 你搜房子的左边，我在右边找找有什么有意思的东西。

lines.en: : So, I’m obviously no expert when it comes to this sort of thing, but I could have sworn you two were supposed to be playing {i}against{/i} each-
lines.zh: : 那么，我显然不是这方面的专家，但我明明记得你俩应该是互相{i}对抗{/i}——

lines.en: : Shh. We need to focus.
lines.zh: : 嘘。我们需要集中注意力。

lines.en: scene black
scene gamerbattle28
: This game has to be bugged. Fatally bugged. That’s why I’ve never heard of it before.
lines.zh: : 这游戏肯定有 bug。而且是致命的 bug。所以我以前才从来没听说过它。

lines.en: : This is our fourth time trying and we still can’t figure out how to get these damn boards off of the windows. Who even designed this nonsense?
lines.zh: : 这都第四次尝试了，我们还是没弄明白该怎么把窗户上这些该死的木板拆下来。到底是哪个家伙设计了这种鬼东西？

lines.en: : We’ll get it soon...we just...have to keep trying...
lines.zh: : 我们很快就会弄好的……我们只要……继续试……

lines.en: : That’s the key to games like this...
lines.zh: : 这就是这类游戏的关键……

lines.en: : Sometimes you...have to...bash your head against the wall...over and over...until you find something different...something that...unlocks the rest of the pieces in the puzzle...
lines.zh: : 有时候你……必须……把头往墙上撞……一次又一次……直到你找到某个不一样的东西……某个能……解开谜题其余碎片的东西……

lines.en: : Yeah, that just sounds like bad game design.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那听起来纯粹就是糟糕的关卡设计。

lines.en: : I think...it’s kind of fun...and...really rewarding...once you finally break the pattern and-
lines.zh: : 我觉得……这挺好玩的……而且……很有成就感……一旦你终于打破了那个模式，然后——

lines.en: scene gamerbattle29
: Wait! That book in the top right corner of the shelf! The one that’s jutting out a little. Click on that. Our next clue could have something to do with-
lines.zh: : 等等！书架右上角那本书！就是稍微突出来的那本。点它。我们的下一条线索可能跟它有关——

lines.en: scene gamerbattle30
: It...it fell down! And...there’s a key inside!
lines.zh: : 它……它掉下来了！而且……里面有把钥匙！

lines.en: : A-ha! So it {i}is{/i} possible after all!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！所以它是{i}真的{/i}可行！

lines.en: scene black
: Try the key on that door in the back of the house, Sana. That’s the only one we haven’t tried yet.
lines.zh: : 拿这把钥匙去试试房子后面那扇门，Sana。那是我们唯一还没试过的了。

lines.en: : It’s...no. It’s not doing anything...
lines.zh: : 它……不。它一点反应都没有……

lines.en: : Tch...we’ll just have to try something else then.
lines.zh: : 啧……那我们只好再试试别的了。

lines.en: Sana and Molly wind up playing their weird, unnamed arcade game for another thirty minutes- paying no attention to anything happening off of the screen they’ve glued their eyes to.
lines.zh: Sana 和 Molly 就这么又玩了三十分钟那款古怪的无名街机游戏——对屏幕之外发生的任何事都置若罔闻，眼睛死死粘在画面上。

lines.en: And while their “contest” manages to devolve into two friends playing the same game for fun instead of competition, there {i}is{/i} a winner as it winds up becoming more of a test of endurance than anything else.
lines.zh: 虽然她们的「比赛」最终退化成两个朋友为了好玩而玩同一款游戏，而不是互相竞争，但因为这场比拼最后更像是耐力的考验，所以{i}还是{/i}分出了胜负。

lines.en: And when it comes to endurance and the depressing act of refusing to detach yourself from the virtual world at any point, there is only one person that will ever come out on top...
lines.zh: 而论到耐力，以及那种无论何时都不肯从虚拟世界里抽身的、令人沮丧的行为，能站到最后的永远只有一个人……

lines.en: scene gamerbattle31
: It’s okay, Sana. I can just not eat next week. You did your best.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Sana。我下周不吃东西就行了。你已经尽力了。

lines.en: : I’m not upset...I...actually had a lot of fun...
lines.zh: : 我不难过……我……其实玩得很开心……

lines.en: : As did I, Sana. We should do this again under better circumstances...on a day where I am not destined to win. Though, I very likely will as I am just that good.
lines.zh: : 我也是，Sana。我们应该在更好的情况下再来一次……挑一个我不是注定会赢的日子。不过，我很可能会赢，因为我就是这么强。

lines.en: : Fuck yeah, Molly. All of that time being a horrible employee has finally earned me money in a really roundabout way!
lines.zh: : 太他妈爽了，Molly。你当糟糕员工的那些时间，总算绕了一大圈替我赚到钱了！

lines.en: : This is the part where I feel like I’m supposed to say I’m proud of you but, seriously, I’m going to have to start taking your phone away when you clock in.
lines.zh: : 按理说这时候我该说「我为你骄傲」，不过说真的，以后你打卡上班我得把你的手机没收了。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Molly. I now understand why I had to be here for this.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Molly。我现在明白为什么非得让我来这儿了。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle32
: To experience firsthand one more example of how great I am as the girl who may potentially be the {i}only{/i} undefeated Dorm Wars competitor by the end of tomorrow night?!
lines.zh: : 为了亲身再体验一次我有多厉害——我可是到明天晚上为止，有可能成为整届宿舍大战{i}唯一{/i}不败的选手的女孩？！

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 行啊。就这么说吧。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sir! I’m glad that I was able to share this experience with you even if you had no idea what was happening at any point and were nearly killed by a dolphin.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，先生！我很高兴能和您分享这段经历，哪怕您从头到尾都没搞懂发生了什么，还差点被一只海豚干掉。

lines.en: : Yeah, the dolphin disappeared a little while ago and I’ve been on edge ever since, so...I’m just going to-
lines.zh: : 是啊，那只海豚刚才消失了，从那以后我一直提心吊胆，所以……我干脆就——

lines.en: A faint tapping on my shoulder reminds me of how fleeting life is.
lines.zh: 肩上轻轻的一拍，让我想起生命有多么短暂。

lines.en: So...if I turn around and come face to face with my demise, there’s something I want you to know.
lines.zh: 所以……如果我转过身，与我的死神面对面，有一件事我想让你知道。

lines.en: scene black
And that something is this:
lines.zh: 而那件事就是：

lines.en: Being around dolphins is exhausting.
lines.zh: 和海豚待在一起，太累人了。

lines.en: That is all.
lines.zh: 就这样。

lines.en: scene gamerbattle33
: Oh. It’s just you.
lines.zh: : 哦。原来是你。

lines.en: : Right. You have to stay in character.
lines.zh: : 对。你得保持角色状态。

lines.en: : I’m assuming that letter is for me?
lines.zh: : 我猜那封信是给我的？

lines.en: : Do not speak...You’ll give away our location...And it is finally gone...
lines.zh: : 别出声……你会暴露我们的位置……而它终于走了……

lines.en: : I understand entirely. Give me the note.
lines.zh: : 我完全理解。把纸条给我。

lines.en: scene black

I snatch the card out of Uta’s hand and turn it over to find that my next “mission” is walking approximately half a mile away from the arcade- a thing I’m definitely excited to do in the midst of summer.
lines.zh: 我从 Uta 手里一把抽过卡片，翻过来一看，我的下一个「任务」是要走到离游戏厅大约半英里远的地方——在盛夏里做这种事，我可真是激动万分。

lines.en: And while that may sound like a complaint (Because it {i}is{/i} one), I’m not {i}entirely{/i} distraught as it appears that this “mission” involves kicking off the date war right away.
lines.zh: 虽然这听起来像是在抱怨（因为它本来就{i}是{/i}），但我并非{i}完全{/i}沮丧，因为看起来这个「任务」就是要立刻启动约会大战。

lines.en: Considering that this is likely going to take several hours, I nod to the rest of the girls and say my goodbyes.
lines.zh: 考虑到这大概要花上好几个小时，我向其余的女孩们点点头，道了别。

lines.en: Unfortunately, all of them know where I am headed due to the Dorm War schedule being public knowledge, so all that happens in saying goodbye is me managing to make everyone jealous before disappearing.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，由于宿舍大战的日程是公开信息，她们全都知道我要去哪儿，所以这番道别唯一的效果，就是在我消失之前成功让所有人都嫉妒了一把。

lines.en: But hey, at least {i}one{/i} person is having a good day so far.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，到目前为止，至少有{i}一个{/i}人今天过得不错。
